author_checks: 2026-10-18 author draft (Claude): 117 original repair items for P2 Chinese and Higher Chinese in three character-recognition groups, each target with a complete exact/similar/generic pool: P1 review look-alike/sound-alike characters (16 targets: 东 九 以 午 厂 右 土 天 学 怎 本 牛 白 给 见 走), P2 look-alike/sound-alike set 3 (10 targets: 像 全 医 发 吧 绿 读 身 那 鸟) and P2 textbook words beyond the official lists (13 targets: 兽 喷 塘 密 察 橡 烛 瓶 胶 蜡 警 酒 魔). No general-practice items or materials: these groups extend repair routes only.

Drafted one set of four to five targets at a time; every item read rendered with its blank and options; common checks 1-11 and Chinese checks ZH1-ZH5 run on each item. A script checked every stem, option, hint and explanation against the cumulative P1-P2 official lists (CL and HCL): no character outside them except the tested target and, in the textbook-extras group, the group's own approved characters (for example 警 in 警察, 蜡 in 蜡烛) and 墙 in one context. Hints were checked for containing the key. No pinyin is used in this batch.

Distractor substitution: every wrong option was put in the blank and read as a sentence. Options that formed a real word but a wrong sentence were kept only where the sentence is clearly wrong (工长里, 中年十二点, 水平里); 场 is not offered for 工厂 blanks because 工场 is also a word. The 厂 exact item instead asks which sentence is written correctly (工厂 vs 足球场). The left/right item uses two hands rather than road crossing, because Singapore traffic comes from the right first.

Known limits: P1 review targets come from the proposed P1 review list (zh-2024-p1-review.2) and textbook extras from the owner-approved list in the same file; the batch cannot ship before that list is approved. 像 items offer 象 as a distractor; 好象 is an older variant spelling, and the key follows current standard usage (好像). One 酒 item says adults drink it and children must not. Recognition only; handwriting is not assessed.

Sources: P2 school exercise formats and textbook vocabulary were reviewed privately to choose question types and the textbook-extras list. No worksheet, textbook or past-paper wording, answer or learner information is used. As with every public group, the targets are generic curriculum content, not a record of any learner's errors.
Owner sample: 24 of 117 items, ceil(N/5), random.Random('zh-starter-003-v1-owner-sample-2026-10-18').sample(pool, ceil(len(pool)/5)) over batch order; no items disputed.
Pending: independent cross-review (ChatGPT) of all items, owner review of the sample, rights decision and batch sign-off; approval of the P1 review and textbook-extras list.
